description: Prepare renewing .eth names for the user to sign in their own wallet, e.g. 'Renew nick.eth for a year'. Nothing is sent. Anyone can renew any name, while it is registered or in its grace period. Paid in USDC by default, or DAI. Returns the steps, cost, what the account needs, whether it would succeed, plain signing instructions and the unsigned calls.

account.description: Account that will sign the transactions: an address (0x…) or an ENS name

items.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

paymentToken.description: Token to pay with: usdc (default) or dai

name: renew_names

calls.description: Unsigned calls, in order, for the account's wallet

eth.description: ETH the calls send, besides gas

raw.description: Exact amount in the smallest unit

gas.description: Gas limit of the steps that can be checked now

deploys.description: Contracts the plan deploys, at addresses known in advance

issues.description: Why a checked step would fail

plan.description: Handle of this plan for get_plan; pass it back unchanged

requirements.description: What the account needs before signing, e.g. a token balance

signing.description: How to sign the steps, in plain words

checked.description: A step that depends on earlier ones can only be checked once they confirm

willSucceed.description: Whether the steps that can be checked now would succeed if signed now

title: Prepare a renewal
